heading: Agreements on aircraft sabotage, aircraft hijacking, and airport security
lead: The Secretary of State shall seek multilateral and bilateral agreement on strengthening enforcement measures and standards for compliance related to aircraft sabotage, aircraft hijacking, and airport security.
